reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 19. Nay or No: 17. Not Voting: 4. Of 36 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 34 (94%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 208 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

Happy Veterans Day!

Today, we honor the brave men and women who sacrificed to serve and protect our nation and freedom. I’ll keep fighting in Congress to honor the legacy of service members like the Tuskegee Airmen and to ensure that our veterans have the support they deserve. https://t.co/q8Fdt5IbfX

Bill Spotlight: Today is National First Responders Day - a time to recognize and honor the brave first responders who work tirelessly to keep our communities safe and healthy no matter the circumstance. 

I'm proud to have introduced the Public Service Educational Assistance Act, a bipartisan bill that gives back to first responders and other critical public service workers by covering the cost of college or job training for their dependents.

Several counties heavily impacted by Hurricane Isaias are in my district. That is why I am urging the White House to declare a major disaster declaration for the state of Alabama. Full letter below.
https://t.co/RpB8PHDA8R https://t.co/Ar24yj9Yg4

Record-breaking diesel prices affect us all.

These prices are making the cost of everyday goods rise and are hurting hardworking families in my district. It’s time for the President to end the war in Iran and focus on lowering costs for all Americans. https://t.co/qD7FQoDpbl

Bill Spotlight: Every child deserves the opportunity to pursue extracurricular activities that shape character, build skills, and prepare them for future success. 

That's why earlier this year, I introduced the Affordable Youth Enrichment Opportunities Act to create a $5,000 tax break for families who pay out-of-pocket expenses for their children's activities.

Thanks to Trump and Republicans in Congress, prices keep going up, making it harder for Alabama families to make ends meet.

It’s time for the President to focus on making life more affordable for all Americans instead of prioritizing giving tax breaks to his billionaire donors.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
